import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        // Read number of test cases
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        String[] aStr = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        String[] bStr = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[3];
        int[] b = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aStr[i]);
            b[i] = Integer.parseInt(bStr[i]);
        }

        List<int[]> perms = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] permArray = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6};
        permute(permArray, 0, perms);

        int maxMatch = Math.min(a[0], b[1]) + Math.min(a[1], b[2]) + Math.min(a[2], b[0]);
        int maxScore = 0;

        for (int[] perm : perms) {
            int[] aCopy = a.clone();
            int[] bCopy = b.clone();
            int score = 0;
            for (int el : perm) {
                switch (el) {
                    case 1:
                        int t1 = Math.min(aCopy[0], bCopy[0]);
                        aCopy[0] -= t1;
                        bCopy[0] -= t1;
                        score += t1;
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        int t2 = Math.min(aCopy[0], bCopy[2]);
                        aCopy[0] -= t2;
                        bCopy[2] -= t2;
                        score += t2;
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        int t3 = Math.min(aCopy[1], bCopy[1]);
                        aCopy[1] -= t3;
                        bCopy[1] -= t3;
                        score += t3;
                        break;
                    case 4:
                        int t4 = Math.min(aCopy[1], bCopy[0]);
                        aCopy[1] -= t4;
                        bCopy[0] -= t4;
                        score += t4;
                        break;
                    case 5:
                        int t5 = Math.min(aCopy[2], bCopy[2]);
                        aCopy[2] -= t5;
                        bCopy[2] -= t5;
                        score += t5;
                        break;
                    case 6:
                        int t6 = Math.min(aCopy[2], bCopy[1]);
                        aCopy[2] -= t6;
                        bCopy[1] -= t6;
                        score += t6;
                        break;
                }
            }
            maxScore = Math.max(maxScore, score);
        }

        System.out.print((n - maxScore) + " " + maxMatch);
    }

    static void permute(int[] arr, int l, List<int[]> perms) {
        if (l == arr.length) {
            perms.add(arr.clone());
        } else {
            for (int i = l; i < arr.length; i++) {
                swap(arr, l, i);
                permute(arr, l + 1, perms);
                swap(arr, l, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }
}
